capabilities: Export single notes, folders, or selected files as PDF, DOCX, EPUB, Markdown bundles, or HTML
Merge a folder or selection into one document with a table of contents
Expand note embeds into exports with cycle detection and a depth limit
Preserve directory structure and copy attachments with rewritten links
Track export progress with a cancelable progress bar
extras: PDF export is desktop-only and not offered on mobile; DOCX and EPUB use basic conversion without exact visual parity with Obsidian; block-reference embeds are not expanded, Dataview queries are not executed during export, and Canvas files are unsupported. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to export folders of notes to document formats like Word, EPUB, or Markdown bundles while preserving structure, attachments, and embeds.
summary: Batch export tool that converts notes, folders, or selected files into PDF, Word, EPUB, Markdown bundles, and standalone HTML documents.
